recommendations: Provide authoritative dataset reuse terms, applicable regulatory classification, and a responsible governance contact.
Document ethics review or an applicable waiver, patient consent or waiver, deidentification methods, re-identification risk, and vulnerable-population safeguards.
Supply a release-specific variable dictionary, actual split definitions and subset-role flags, and fuller cohort eligibility and demographic information.
Report applied sampling, missingness, anomalies, known limitations, categorized biases, sensitive content, and downstream social impacts.
Add a dataset version, recommended citation, named publication platform, version-access instructions, change history, and maintenance schedule.
Describe collection procedures and time coverage, clarify imputation use, and provide authoritative absolute protocol and documentation URLs.

passed: The NIH award identifier agrees across the funder and principal-investigator descriptions.
The documented research purposes align with the stated Bridge2AI critical-care funding context.
The differently timed admission counts do not establish a numerical contradiction.
The contributing-hospital count and collaborating-center count have distinct, consistent scopes.
Planned labeling, holdout construction, final expansion, and pending EEG extraction are qualified rather than asserted as completed release properties.
The GitHub project license is explicitly distinguished from dataset reuse terms.
warnings: Patient-record collection intervals and release dates are insufficiently specified to verify a complete collection-to-publication chronology.
The deidentification description lacks a method and residual-risk assessment, while making no blanket claim that all data are already deidentified.
The clinical cohort lacks oversight and consent documentation; no explicit human_subject_research Boolean is present to establish a contradictory Boolean claim.

correctness_validations.contact_email: The program-manager address contains the source-spelled domain mgh.havard.edu; its correctness is unverified. The record explicitly preserves that spelling.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: valid_nih_structure: OT2OD032701 and 1OT2OD032701-01 are internally consistent; award existence was not externally checked
correctness_validations.url_validity: The supplied HTTPS URLs are structurally plausible. www.bridge2ai.org/chorus lacks a scheme. Live resolution and accessibility were not checked.
